contract.scope: unchanged canonical field multiply/square arithmetic under API/directASM/inlineRow/separateTUrow boundaries; no production, CT, novelty or upper-layer claim
contract.work: 1024 canonical steps per active lane; chain1 or four independent one-core lanes; no lazy sum state
contract.multiply: x=mul(x,rhs[step&255]); canonical nonzero seeds/RHS; actual returning FE64 API is reference
contract.square: x=square(x); no RHS mixing; trace reports actual zero/one states
contract.native_admission: caller checks Linux x86-64 ASM/BMI2/ADX support before any trace or job; native direct wrappers have no added per-call dispatch
contract.boundaries: API retains production returning operators; directASM and outlinedRow call external pointer/output leaves; inlineRow uses unchanged P5 arithmetic; separateTU and fno-lto preserve row boundary
contract.output: fixed128bytes per job: active lanes in lane order, each BE32; chain1 has96inactive zero bytes; all128 observable and hashed
contract.timing: seed initialization,1024steps/lane,whole job call and final raw-to-FE/BE32 serialization plus zero padding included; allocation/generation/validation excluded
contract.loop: noinline/noipa whole jobs plus output memory barrier; no per-step benchmark barrier; route dispatch outside job loop
contract.validation: untimed each-step helper trace: canonical raw limbs and all32bytes vs FE64 reference; complete compiled evaluator and job outputs must match final trace; last identical job per region checked outside clock
contract.trace_limit: trace helpers are separate from complete compiled loops; hashes cover every active state BE32; trace is not Boost oracle or timed instrumentation
contract.preservation: regenerate all4seeds,256canonical RHS,256raw512 values after prevalidation and after regions/failure; compare every raw word and fullbyte hash
contract.calibration: retain all attempts; two consecutive>=floor regions at same count; grow ceil(1.5*target*jobs/elapsed), capped
contract.region_duration: warmup/measurement append whole batches under one continuous clock until floor; no discarded prefix/restart; use actual total jobs*1024*lanes
contract.probes: fixed preallocated storage; intermediate clock checks/stores/continuation are timed; terminal serialization and probe conversion outside clock
contract.failure: floor/extension/work failures prevent complete status and retain raw records; only verified duration-qualified measurements enter ratios
contract.ordering: seeded4group/4route-slot permutation plus round rotation/reversal; second series reverses complete order
contract.ratio: same-round numerator ns/operation divided by denominator ns/operation; >1 favors denominator; chain/ILP comparison includes amortized complete-job costs
contract.cpu: one thread deliberately isolates dependency scheduling; pin externally; endpoint snapshots do not prove no migration or constant frequency; no power policy changes
contract.backend: external manifest binds exact boundaryheader/separateTU/driver/P5kernel/library/binary/compiler flags; harness macros alone do not prove library configuration

corpus.hash_recipe: FNV1a64 unsigned wrap; seedBE32 thenRHSBE32 then eachrawWideBE64(highlimbfirst); fullbytes not lowwords
